 Insurance Executive – Job Description
   

  

 Job Title: Insurance ExecutiveDepartment: Sales / InsuranceExperience: 1–3 YearsLocation: \[Location]Employment Type: Full\-time
   

 Job Summary
   

 We are looking for a motivated and customer\-focused Insurance Executive to handle insurance sales, customer relationships, policy servicing, renewals, and documentation. The candidate will identify customer needs and recommend suitable insurance products.
   

 Key Responsibilities
   

 \- Generate leads and acquire new insurance customers.\- Explain insurance policies, coverage, benefits, terms, and premiums.\- Sell life, health, motor, or general insurance products as applicable.\- Follow up with prospective customers and convert leads into sales.\- Maintain strong relationships with existing customers.\- Assist customers with policy renewals, claims, endorsements, and documentation.\- Ensure accurate completion of application and KYC documents.\- Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.\- Maintain customer and sales records.\- Coordinate with insurance companies and internal teams for policy processing.\- Provide excellent after\-sales service and resolve customer queries.\- Follow company policies and applicable insurance regulations.
   

 Requirements
   

 \- Graduate in any discipline preferred.\- 1–3 years of experience in insurance, banking, financial services, or sales preferred.\- Good communication and interpersonal skills.\- Strong customer\-service and convincing abilities.\- Basic knowledge of MS Office and CRM systems.\- Target\-oriented and self\-motivated.\- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
   

 Key Skills
   

 Insurance Sales \| Customer Relationship Management \| Lead Generation \| Policy Servicing \| Renewals \| Claims Support \| Communication \| Negotiation \| Documentation \| MS Office \| CRM
   

 Salary
   

 ₹15,000 – ₹35,000 per month \+ incentives, depending on experience and company policy.
